controls.suggestionsPlacesUnavailable: Place suggestions are temporarily unavailable. Try a campground name.

controls.suggestionsError: Suggestions are temporarily unavailable. Try again.
controls.maxPriceHint: Parks with at least one matching site at or below this listed nightly rate in the selected currency. No currency conversion — other currencies are excluded when a max price is set.
controls.priceCurrencyScopeNote: Prices in {currency} · parks listed in other currencies are hidden (no conversion).
controls.noResultsCurrencyScope: No parks match this max price in {currency}. Clear the price filter or try another currency.
controls.noResultsForCurrencyScope: No parks match “{query}” with this max price in {currency}. Clear the price filter, try another currency, or change your search.
controls.siteFiltersHint: Shows parks with at least one site that matches selected site types, any selected amp (or None), every selected water/sewer hookup, driveway, rig length, and max price (when set).
controls.dumpStationHint: Park amenity (not the same as sewer at the site).
controls.amenitiesHint: Shows parks that have every selected amenity. Water, sewer, and dump station stay in their own filters.
controls.geoDenied: Location permission was denied. Allow location access to search near you.
controls.geoUnavailable: Could not get your location. Try again or enter a city in the search box.
controls.resultCount: {count, plural, =0 {No campgrounds} one {Showing # campground} other {Showing # campgrounds}}
controls.resultsTruncated: More matches exist — refine your search to see them all.
controls.mapEmpty: No campgrounds with map locations to show.
